style: Existing RSE manuscript style: Arial, 6.5 pt body, 8 pt panel labels, teal AE and neutral grey S2
role: Data and method illustration; no inference on accuracy or prevalence

parcel_labels.claim: Each crop reference is a geographic parcel record carrying a reported crop identity, subsequently harmonised into an analysis class.

panels.a: Actual 2021 orthophotography and recorded field boundaries
panels.b: Same extent with crop classes and a traceable highlighted label record

centroid_features.claim: The same parcel reference is paired with AE and S2 features through centroid sampling of neighbourhood summary images.

panels.a: Real polygon, saved centroid and nominal neighbourhood
panels.b: Magnified neighbourhood with explicitly schematic pixel grid
panels.c: Spatial mean and standard deviation per input channel, giving 128 AE and 168 S2 features

integrity.selection: A geographically selected Flanders site, not selected by model accuracy; all source parcels intersecting the selected map window retained
integrity.orthophoto: Official 2021 winter mosaic; visual context only, not model inputs or source of labels
integrity.centroid: Saved production coordinates checked against raw polygon centroid in WGS84
integrity.kernel: Code uses a circular 3-pixel neighbourhood; 30 m and 10 m grid are nominal illustrative geometry, not reconstruction of Earth Engine pixel registration
integrity.statistics: None; dimensional counts from extraction code; no synthetic quantitative feature values

placement: Two reviewable figure candidates; manuscript layout not changed in this turn
